mapper.select: select * from eng_wrong_word where user_id=#{userId} and article_id=#{articleId} and word_id=#{wordId}
mapper.insert: insert into eng_wrong_word(user_id,article_id,word_id,wrong_count,mastered,create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time) values(#{userId},#{articleId},#{wordId},1,0,#{createBy},now(),#{updateBy},now()) on duplicate key update wrong_count=wrong_count+1,mastered=0,update_by=values(update_by),update_time=now()
mapper.select: select count(*) from eng_wrong_word where user_id=#{userId} and mastered=#{mastered}
